geo_priorities.title: Add a stronger answer-first intro
geo_priorities.why: AI answer systems prefer pages that explain the topic clearly in the first visible block.
geo_priorities.fix_now: Add a short opening summary that defines the topic or service in 50-150 words.

geo_priorities.title: Support claims with source-like references

geo_priorities.fix_now: Add documentation, studies, official sources, or other supporting references near factual claims.

geo_priorities.title: Expose visible author or expert attribution
